sources.snippet: For instance, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B is upcycled from Qwen-1.8B. It has 14.3B parameters in total and 2.7B activated parameters during runtime, while achieving comparable performance to Qwen1.5-7B, it only requires 25% of the training resources.

sources.title: Qwen1.5 MoE A2.7B - 2.7B | OpenModelMap
sources.snippet: Qwen1.5 MoE A2.7B is a Mixture of Experts model from the Tongyi Qianwen series, featuring a total parameter count of 2.7B with fewer activated parameters. This architecture delivers text generation capabilities comparable to larger models while maintaining low inference costs.
